note: Single-voice (virtual idol) narration. `at` and `max` are seconds on the film timeline (zh 181.6 s on ピコピコひらめきタイム (Full), en 180 s on Pixel Town Disco; the zh extra goes to the end card). Text uses Fish Audio S2 bracket cues. The keynote multi-voice draft is kept in voiceover/_keynote/.

zh.instruction: 一位虚拟电子歌姬风格的少女声线：音色明亮、偏高、清脆可爱，带一点合成器般的电子质感和轻微的机械感，吐字干净利落，语气活泼又亲切，像二次元虚拟偶像在给大家介绍小镇。普通话，安静的录音棚。
zh.reference_text: 欢迎来到小镇。这里的每个居民，都有自己的名字、性格和记忆，我带你慢慢逛一逛。

en.instruction: A virtual pop idol style voice inspired by vocal-synth singers: a bright, high-pitched, crisp and cute young female voice with a subtle synthesized, slightly robotic digital sheen, clean articulation, upbeat and friendly, like an anime virtual idol introducing her town. Clean studio recording.
en.reference_text: Welcome to town. Everyone who lives here has a name, a personality and a memory of their own. Let me show you around.

zh.instruction: 成熟男声，男性主讲人，三十多岁，低沉、醇厚的男中音，语速从容，像在产品发布会舞台上讲一个打动人的故事，自信真诚，有停顿和起伏，不播音腔。普通话男声，安静的录音棚。
zh.reference_text: 我们一直在想一个问题：如果它不只是一个工具，而是一个真正的伙伴，会是什么样？

en.instruction: A male keynote presenter in his thirties with a warm, rich baritone. Calm, confident storytelling pace with natural pauses, sincere and inspiring, like telling the story behind a product on stage. Not a radio announcer. Clean studio recording.
en.reference_text: We kept asking ourselves one question. What if it was not just a tool, but a real teammate?

zh.instruction: 一位接受采访的年轻女性开发者，声音自然松弛、中等音高，带着笑意和一点小兴奋，像在纪录片采访里回忆做产品的故事，口语化、真诚、亲近，近距离采访麦克风。普通话。
zh.reference_text: 其实最开始我们就决定了，记忆不要藏起来，要让大家都能打开看看。

en.instruction: A young female software developer being interviewed for a documentary. Natural, relaxed, mid-pitched voice, smiling and a little excited, conversational and sincere, like recalling how the product came together. Close interview microphone.
en.reference_text: Honestly, from day one we decided memory should never be hidden. Anyone should be able to open it up.

cues.zh: [excited] 开源的 Grok Bot 替代品，为 DeepSeek Harness 而生！
cues.en: [excited] The open-source Grok Bot alternative, built for DeepSeek Harness!
cues.speaker: idol

cues.zh: 记忆就是 Git！
cues.en: Memory is Git!
cues.speaker: idol

cues.zh: 住进飞书和 Slack！
cues.en: It lives in Lark and Slack!
cues.speaker: idol

cues.zh: 在群里和你一起干活！
cues.en: It works with you in Groups!
cues.speaker: idol

cues.zh: [playful] 头像还会随工作变形！
cues.en: [playful] And its avatar morphs as it works!
cues.speaker: idol

cues.zh: [warm] 这里是 DeepSeekBot 小镇。住在这儿的，是一群有自己名字、性格和记忆的 bot。
cues.en: [warm] Welcome to DeepSeekBot Town, home to bots that each have a name, a personality, and a memory of their own.
cues.speaker: idol

cues.zh: 像 Grok Bot 一样，你可以像找同事那样，给 bot 发消息、派活儿。[break] 在群里艾特谁，谁就来接话，几个 bot 还能同时开工。
cues.en: Like Grok Bot, you message your bots and hand them work, the way you would with teammates. [break] Mention one in a Group and it picks up, and several can work at once.
cues.speaker: idol

cues.zh: 用 Claude 或 Codex 时，你得自己决定每件事该去哪个 session 聊。[break] 在这里，你对人不对事：建一个虚拟伙伴、虚拟员工，有事直接找它。
cues.en: With Claude or Codex, you decide which session each task belongs in. [break] Here you talk to people, not tasks: create a virtual teammate, and just ask.
cues.speaker: idol

cues.zh: 再让它加入飞书群，像同事一样帮你总结消息、跟进话题。[break] 有人艾特它，它读完来龙去脉，就在原话题里答复。
cues.en: Add it to your Lark group, and like any colleague it summarizes messages and follows topics. [break] When someone tags it, it reads the context and answers right in the thread.
cues.speaker: idol

cues.zh: Slack 里丢来一个压缩包，它处理完，再把结果送回去。
cues.en: Drop a ZIP in Slack, and the result comes back to the same thread.
cues.speaker: idol

cues.zh: 飞书、Slack、Discord 和微信都已接通，每个 bot 都用自己的身份，出现在你的团队里。
cues.en: Lark, Slack, Discord and WeChat are all connected, and every bot joins your team as itself.
cues.speaker: idol

cues.zh: 它们会记住和你有关的一切：你的偏好、你的项目、你们聊过的话。[break] 这些记忆都看得见，随时打开，看看它记住了什么。
cues.en: They remember what matters to you: your preferences, your projects, your conversations. [break] And their memory is open, so you can always see what they kept.
cues.speaker: idol

cues.zh: 每学到一点新东西，它都在成长。想知道它为什么改了主意？点开就能看到。
cues.en: Every new thing it learns helps it grow. Wonder why it changed its mind? Just open it.
cues.speaker: idol

cues.zh: [warm] 陪你一年以后，它攒下了满满一年的回忆，比谁都懂你。
cues.en: [warm] After a year together, it holds a whole year of memories, and knows you better than anyone.
cues.speaker: idol

cues.zh: 它不只是陪伴，还能和你一起学习、一起工作。
cues.en: It's more than company: it learns with you, and works with you.
cues.speaker: idol

cues.zh: 记错了也不怕，随时能回到过去，重新来过。
cues.en: And if it remembers something wrong, you can always go back.
cues.speaker: idol

cues.zh: 甚至能从一个 Git 仓库，捏出一个新 bot。
cues.en: You can even grow a new bot from a repo.
cues.speaker: idol

cues.zh: [hopeful] 再往前想一步：如果把一个 bot 的灵魂打包分享出去，会发生什么？
cues.en: [hopeful] Now picture this: you package the soul of a bot, and share it with the world.
cues.speaker: idol

cues.zh: 它飞过云层，落到世界各地的工作台上，被一次又一次地 Import。
cues.en: It rises above the clouds and lands on desks around the world, imported again and again.
cues.speaker: idol

cues.zh: 同一个起点，走出不同的人生。[break] 因为记忆是 Git，这些世界线还能合并回来，收束成一个更丰富的她。
cues.en: One origin, many lives. [break] And because memory is Git, those world lines can merge back into someone richer.
cues.speaker: idol

cues.zh: [amused] 忙起来的时候，连头像都会跟着变。
cues.en: [amused] When they get busy, even their faces change.
cues.speaker: idol

cues.zh: [playful] 换个舞台，它们也能是骑士、贤者和吟游诗人，陪你闯一回史莱姆洞窟。而这段冒险，也会好好地留在它们各自的记忆里。
cues.en: [playful] Change the stage, and they become a knight, a sage and a bard, ready for an adventure with you. [warm] And yes, they will remember this one too.
cues.speaker: idol

cues.zh: 每个 bot，都能长成独一无二的样子。
cues.en: Every bot can grow into something entirely its own.
cues.speaker: idol

cues.zh: 创建、分享、Import，然后一起生活。[curious] 当成百上千个有记忆的 bot 住在一起，会长出怎样的故事？
cues.en: Create, share, import, and live together. [curious] When hundreds of bots with memories share a town, what stories will grow?
cues.speaker: idol

cues.zh: [warm] 在开源生态里，打造属于你的 Bot，再把它分享给所有人。[break] 它们不只陪你工作和学习，还能和你一起生活。
cues.en: [warm] In an open-source ecosystem, you build your own bot and share it with everyone. [break] They don't just work and learn with you. They live alongside you, too.
cues.speaker: idol

cues.zh: Bot Harness，开源，基于 DeepSeek Harness 生态。
cues.en: Bot Harness. Open source, built on DeepSeek Harness.
cues.speaker: idol
